text:
Zoe: Quick sync re: upcoming pen test. Need RBAC, KMS key plan, audit export path, retest windows. Who can own?
Carlos: I'll take RBAC + automation. Plan: create role `pt-assessor-${id}` with session duration 4h.
Mei: KMS: new key alias `alias/pt_evidence_1801234567`, grants only to role. Revoke grant at window end.
Rahul: Logs: export CloudTrail + app logs to `s3://rw-pt-evidence/1801234567/`. Presigned PUTs 6h.
Zoe: Can infra auto-provision presigned keys?
audit-bot: Ticket RW-PT-2026-1801234567 created and assigned to Carlos, Mei.
Carlos: IAM assume role sample:
```json
{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Action":"sts:AssumeRole","Resource":"arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/pt-assessor-1801234567"}]}
```
Mei: KMS grant CLI:
`aws kms create-grant --key-id alias/pt_evidence_1801234567 --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/pt-assessor-1801234567 --operations Encrypt Decrypt`
Rahul: We'll add checksum verifier lambda and CloudTrail export verification.
Zoe: Retest slots: Fri 10:00-11:00 and Fri 14:00-15:00. Add to ticket.
Carlos: I'll push terraform module for role+grant+revocation and ping for dry-run.
Mei: I'll set bucket lifecycle and SIEM mirror.
Zoe: Action owners: Carlos (RBAC/automation), Mei (KMS + retention), Rahul (logs + verifier). Dry-run Thu 08:00.
Carlos: PR incoming.
Mei: ack.
Zoe: Thanks everyone. Keep thread updated with PR link and grant IDs.
